description.en: The description of the virtual router. The description must be 2 to 256 characters long and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the region where the virtual router is deployed. You can call the `DescribeRegions` operation to obtain the most recent list of regions.
The ID of the VRouter to modify.

The name of the virtual router. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-vrouter-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vrouter-id example-string --vrouter-name example-string --description example-string --region cn-hangzhou
